hero.title: Upload a screenshot and forge ranked teams from the recognized roster.
hero.copy: Crew Forge reads the portraits from your screenshot, lets you correct each slot when needed, and then builds the strongest team combinations based on distinct ability coverage.

roster.title: Recognition and corrections
roster.copy: Upload a roster screenshot, review the detected portraits slot by slot, and correct any mismatch before running the build.
roster.minimum: At least {{count}} unique recognized characters are required before teams can be built.

imageImport.title: Upload screenshot
imageImport.copy: The screenshot is matched automatically against a local exact-dimensions profile before portrait recognition runs.
imageImport.empty: Upload a roster screenshot to start recognition.
imageImport.processing: Crew Forge is analyzing the screenshot...
imageImport.previewCopy: {{count}} unique characters are ready for build.

picker.title: Pick character
picker.copy: Override this slot when the recognition result picked the wrong portrait.

errors.invalidType: Only image files can be imported.
errors.loadFailed: The screenshot could not be loaded.
errors.recognitionFailed: Crew Forge could not analyze this screenshot.
errors.noProfile: No matching exact profile is available for this screenshot.
errors.profileMismatch: The exact profile does not match the current screenshot dimensions.
errors.noProfileForDimensions: Screenshot size {{width}} × {{height}} is not supported yet.

results.title: Ranked team results
results.copy: Each result is built only from the characters recognized or corrected in the screenshot.
results.emptyState: Upload a screenshot, confirm the recognized portraits, and press build to see ranked teams.
results.empty: No valid teams could be assembled from the current recognized roster.
results.loading: Crew Forge is evaluating the best team combinations...
results.noUniqueAbilities: No unique builder abilities were parsed for this team.
results.noDuplicateAbilities: This team does not duplicate any parsed builder abilities.
